71 and 72 Frenet-Serret formulas The following formulas, called the Frenet-Serret formulas, are of fundamental importance in differential geometry:

  1. 𝑑⁢𝐓∕𝑑⁢𝑠=𝜅⁢𝐍

  2. 𝑑⁢𝐍∕𝑑⁢𝑠=−⁢𝜅⁢𝐓+𝜏⁢B

  3. 𝑑⁢𝐁∕𝑑⁢𝑠=−⁢𝜏⁢𝐍

(Formula 1 comes from Exercise 63 and Formula 3 is Equation 12.)

  • 71.

    Use the fact that 𝐍=𝐁×𝐓 to deduce Formula 2 from Formulas 1 and 3.

    3. 𝐫′′′=[𝑠′′′−𝜅2⁢(𝑠′)3]⁢𝐓+[3⁢𝜅⁢𝑠′⁢𝑠′′+𝜅′⁢(𝑠′)2]⁢𝐍+𝜅⁢𝜏⁢(𝑠′)3⁢𝐁
